title: Testing BonBon feature
content:
We're trying to get things nice and clean so we can rep the features of the product, but I have to say I am quite confused myself. It's okay, I like the feeling.

I know this is a productive direction and that the 35 year old web is waiting to be unlocked from the horrors Netscape, Microsoft and Google inflicted on it.

It's getting so safe, but then remember life itself isn't safe. Falling in love is definitely not safe but how could you deny it when it comes. Think of BonBon as being like that, like love. And basically trust that text with simple features, is safe enough to use with confidence.

The test -- do inline images render properly in BonBon.

Happy people enjoying a perfect ski holiday in the Rockies.

Screen shot of this page in BonBon, and the Markdown source it's rendered from.
